huggingface_safetensors.notes: Directly loadable in PyTorch / HuggingFace speculative workflows.

vllm_speculative.notes: Compatible with vLLM Medusa speculative engine via `--speculative-model`.

llama_cpp_gguf.blocker: llama.cpp's `--model-draft` natively requires a standalone CausalLM architecture with complete transformer blocks. Medusa multi-head auxiliary projection heads on frozen base hidden states require specialized GGUF quantization tensor mappings (`medusa.0.weight`) not present in standard GGUF conversion scripts. Native llama-speculative currently prioritizes separate SLM draft models.

ollama.blocker: Ollama does not expose a native multi-head Medusa speculative decoding endpoint as of current stable releases. Serving Medusa requires vLLM or our dedicated high-throughput PyTorch runtime.
